frequency_question: How often does an administrative attempt by the Department of Education to terminate an accreditor's recognition succeed in reaching a final, binding revocation within a short administrative window?
membership_rule: Includes formal Department of Education actions initiated to strip a recognized accrediting agency of its national recognition; excludes voluntary relinquishments or routine renewals.

cases.name: American Bar Association (ABA) initial departmental review challenges / probationary actions
ACICS (Accrediting Council for Independent Colleges and Schools) termination round 1
ACICS termination round 2 (final deregistration after reinstatement attempts)

coverage_note: 4 major contested institutional/programmatic accreditation challenge cycles identified; covers the universe of high-stakes federal challenges to major accreditors.
known_gaps: Minor advisory committee recommendations that did not reach formal departmental execution phase are excluded.
skeleton: Total administrative challenges to recognized accrediting agencies by the Department of Education resulting in terminal revocation vs. those resulting in settlement, renewal, or procedural stalling.
multiplier: 2 successful total revocations out of 4 major contested challenge proceedings since 1994.
validity_reason: Administrative law standards and the statutory criteria for recognizing accreditors under the Higher Education Act remain stable across multi-year presidential cycles.
